note: The folio wall (folio-wall.mjs). Hand-authored. A folio: id, title, maker ('maker' for the site's own, otherwise a reader's handle), made, glassed (ISO dates), digital (true for a flat image, false for a laminated scan), chamber (chapter it stands near), optional subject/lc/dewey (else the chapter's first shelf-mate is shown), note (what it is standing next to), alt, layers[] oldest→newest each { scan, date }. A folio seasons once a 13th or 26th passes after `glassed`.

folios.title: LORE . LAND — the sapling on its island
folios.note: The wordmark over a still lake at night; the bud sigil above it. The second layer is the same page cropped for a card — glassed over the first the same day.
folios.alt: LORE . LAND in gold capitals over a dark teal lake, a bare sapling on a small island beneath a gold seed-bud sigil.

folios.title: A nook with a window
folios.note: Rain on the glass, books on the sill. One of seven rooms the chapters read in at lamplight.
folios.alt: A dim reading nook: a rain-streaked window, stacked books on the sill, a lamp glowing warm.

folios.title: The thin gold tree
folios.note: A branching line floating in a forest of teal and amber lights. Stands near the grove that answers a beat late.
folios.alt: A thin gold branching tree floating in soft-focus teal and amber lights, LORE . LAND set low.

folios.title: Boonhonk, as a jazz motif
folios.note: An early study of the sound the Fool makes: bent brass, sampled and returned. Seasoned long ago; clear.
folios.alt: An abstract interface study with a warm brass jazz motif.

folios.title: Boon, Bane, Bone
folios.note: Three lands in three colours, before they had questions. Stands near the timber hall that asks what will remain.
folios.alt: A bright abstract study in three colour fields with a smooth texture.

folios.title: lore.land, abstracted
folios.note: The first shape the site had before it had a furrow. Kept as the oldest layer of the whole wall.
folios.alt: An abstract composition in the site's early palette.
